notes.title: Update
notes.content:
It has been a little while so I wanted to give a little update on things.

We just got back from Maryland to our home in Indiana a couple of weeks ago. I had successful bone marrow transplant done in January at the NIH (National Institutes of Health) in Maryland. I just got the call that the UAB1 test came back, and I no longer have VEXAS. This is the best news. It is still a long road to full recovery but the is such great news. I still have to wait until July when I go back for my follow up and have a bone marrow biopsy done to see if the Blood Cancer is gone but the doctors are very confident that it is gone as well. This journey has been a roller coaster of emotions. I am so thankful for my donor who has blessed me with a second chance at life. Even through these difficult times God has blessed us in so many ways. We are very thankful.

I was not able to work on or do any updates to either Morels game while I was out in Maryland. The project files that I had access to for the games would just constantly crash. I do not know if it was an issue with the laptop I was using or an issue with the project files. 

I spent most of my time in Maryland just trying to recover from the transplant and then working on my solo game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108130/Bigfoot_Life/]Bigfoot Life[/url]. We have also started to work on the next Morels game. Morels: Out of this World. I can't wait to share more information on this game. The goal was when I got back I was going to do an update for both Morels games based on a lot of the feedback I've seen posted in the Steam Hubs. I also released a demo of Bigfoot life and entered it in the Steam Next Fest. Well, this has ended up being a little too much all at once and I've actually started to get a little bit of GVHD (Graft Versus Host Disease). The doctors believe it could just be from stress of over doing it with the game stuff. They have suggested that I step back a little and give my body more time to heal from the transplant. I decided to pulled Bigfoot Life out of the Steam Fest as well.

I am still planning on doing the updates to the Morels games as well as give out more information on the new game. Right now though I've decided from feedback from my doctor's that it is best if I ease back into things and don't feel so rushed to do everything. Recovery from the transplant takes a long time and I have to prioritize my health. So, the updates and information on the new game are coming. They may just take a little longer than I originally was hoping.

Thank you for all of your support and understanding.

-Wes
Abrams Studios

Things have gone pretty well with the Bone Marrow Transplant at the NIH in Maryland. I was admitted on January 22nd and successfully had the transplant done on January 29th. There have been a few rough days as to be expected but overall things have been going pretty well. Right now, I have successfully engrafted with the Donor's cells, and I might be looking at being discharged from the NIH this week if things stay on track. I will then have to stay near by the NIH for weekly tests and doctor visits until 100 days post-transplant. If everything goes well, I could be looking at returning back home to Indiana in May Some time. Feeling extra thankful for my donor and how things have gone so far. Thank you for all your support.

[h3]What's Next[/h3]

The next update will most likely be in May once I get back home to indiana. Besides updating the Morels Games. We are also looking into starting development on our next game. Thank you again for all your support. We are excited to take part in this event and help out the children at GOSH.

notes.title: Development and Health Updates
notes.content:
I just wanted to take a moment to share the most recent update on my health issue as well address what that will mean for future updates and game developments.

[h2]Health Updates[/h2]

The NIH (National Institutes of Health) in Maryland have found a donor and I have an official bone marrow transplant date. The actual transplant date is January 29th. Testing will begin on January 7th. We will have to stay in the area until at least the middle of May. My family and I will make the temporary move from Indiana to Maryland at the beginning of January. If the transplant is successful, it could cure both the VEXAS and the blood cancer. This journey has been a rollercoaster of emotions. I am so thankful for my donor who has blessed me with a second chance at life. Even through these difficult times God has blessed us in so many ways. We are very thankful.

[h2]What does this mean for future updates and game development?[/h2]

I think we may be able to squeeze out one more update before starting this journey in January. If there are any issues that need to be addressed or fixed please let us know. Also let us know if there are any updates that you would like to see and we will see if we can get them in the game before January.

I should still be able to check support messages and try to keep up on here as well. I would imagine the first couple of months this may be more difficult, but I will do my best. As for actual updates or bug fixes, those most likely will depend on how recovery is going after transplant.

[h2]Other News[/h2]

Thank you to everyone for the support!

notes.title: Announcing Morels: Homestead Coming to Oculus Quest Platform December 7th!
notes.content:
Abrams Studios is pleased to announce our next game Morels: Homestead, coming to the Oculus Quest platform on December 7, 2021. Morels: Homestead is a VR gaming experience about building your very own homestead, growing and harvesting crops, exploring and digging up treasure, trading and selling your way to glory as your story grows. 

Have a look at the Official Trailer.
[previewyoutube=Dx5_H94ZMa8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Description[/h2]

In this sandbox VR adventure you’ll start with a blank canvas of empty land. Explore levels from many environments and find hundreds of unique items to keep for yourself or trade to grow your homestead into whatever you wish. Grow and harvest crops, hunt for the elusive Morel mushroom, and find rarities to give you valuable commodities for trade. Use your metal detector and trusty shovel to find and secure many different treasures. Let out your inner nature enthusiast and photograph beautiful and sometimes rare animals. The path you take is yours to choose. Every homestead will be unique.


[h2]Features[/h2]

Design and maintain your own homestead.
Collect and harvest crops.
Over 60 animals and insects to discover and photograph.
Features 8 fully explorable maps.
Find hidden treasures using your metal detector.
Explore at night for a whole new experience.
Buy and sell your items at the in-game Farmer’s Market.
Take on quests to earn items or money to purchase things for your homestead.
Forage for mushrooms.
Find and collect treasures of all kinds.
The path you take is yours to choose. Every homestead will be unique.

[h2]Game History[/h2]

After the release of Morels: The Hunt many in the community voiced their desire to see something similar in VR.  We took that request a few steps further, turning a relaxing and immersive PC experience into something unique for the Oculus Platform.  Morels: Homestead is a unique experience as it focuses on relaxation and immersion while completing tasks rather than high intensity interactions like many current VR games.

Steam and Rift Future Release:

We plan on releasing the game on Steam VR and Oculus Rift in 2022 so stay tuned!

notes.title: Morels Update and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We just released an update to the Anniversary Update with some new features, and bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/372df36b999649b28584d5761f12be0f13589eaf.png[/img]

[h1]New Features and Updates[/h1]

[h3]You can now bind multiple things to the same key. [/h3]

A number of you had expressed an interest in being able to pick up mushrooms with the left mouse button. You can now do this and take photos both with the left mouse. If you would like to pick up mushrooms with the left mouse, you can do so by going to Settings, then Input and changing the pickup method to Left Mouse button.

[h3]Loading screen slideshow option[/h3]

You can now Turn Off the Squirrel Pong Loading Screen in Settings under Gameplay. This will set all loading screens to the standard Slideshow Loading Screen and it will move on by itself once the level is loaded.

[h3]Option for old menu screen[/h3]

A few players have mentioned that they liked the old Main Menu Background and Music before the Anniversary Update. You can now choose between the New Main Menu Background and Music and the old one. On the bottom right of the Main Menu you will now see an option to Turn Off the New Main Menu and switch back to the old one.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

-	Fixed Main Menu from stretching on certain size monitors
-	Set energy back to 100 percent when entering a new map.
-	Stop poisonous mushrooms from increasing energy if not on Easy Mode. You can collect poisonous mushrooms but they should not of been increasing your energy or points unless you were on Easy.
-	Fixed Photos from not saving the correct one.
-	Fixed Mushroom Markers from showing you can pick it up when there isn’t one there.
-	Fixed your rotation when dismounting from the horse so you are facing the direction you were looking before you dismounted.
-	Lowered the audio warning that plays when you get a Tick.
-	We believe we have fixed the issue of occasionally not being able to get off of your horse. If this does happen to you, a temporary fix is to open and close the map.
-	Added the Trout to your Career Stats that you can view after your first season. 
-	We are still looking into the fatal error bugs. We have not been able to reproduce it on our end yet.
-	We are still looking into the weekly task bug. We have not been able to reproduce it on our end yet.

We also wanted to apologize for not mentioning that there may be issues when loading old save files on the new update. If you were affected by this, you can send us an email to support@abramsstudios.com and we will do our best to get your save files fixed and running on the new update.

We just want to thank everyone who has been playing Morels and for the positive reviews. It really does mean so much to us.

Happy Hunting!

-The Abrams Studios Team

[h1]New Achievements[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/7afe08516cf6c928bfc8a43384491580783d1494.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/233dca19dc887e6a050eb8b662d25ec95ad770ce.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/0041c03cd7fd44fdea91135070b4d078bad36ef0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/ee82f04ae4fd12f9e405d9150841dfcd8803c74a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/f44bba5d8c472530545d18b374aaa5c8a70cd4ee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/6fd11d433421cf9a6fcd11a6f1e2a9f74ea623c5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/794671cff57444829c846a323aecd7c09d7f1467.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/923d92f76678ce91764bfba355c5441e19f8eb0a.jpg[/img]

[h3]You now can collect all mushrooms, including poisonous mushroom right from the beginning of the game.[/h3]

[h1]MUSHROOM MARKERS[/h1]

[h3]Now choose from several colors of mushroom markers.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/c5073bdac69ae954163654dad656571966ea9ee8.jpg[/img]

[h1]MAP UPDATES[/h1]

[h3]Every location in the game has been updated[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/9f5c950e6a2e2a798a3bf29c8662b0c5be38ffa0.jpg[/img]

[h1]STACKABLE INVENTORY[/h1]

[h3]You inventory is now stackable.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/a215fc9835c7df108df1c0ce6655368e0c590ddc.jpg[/img]

[h1]OTHER NOTABLE UPDATES[/h1]

-	Added 6 new songs to the Acoustic playlist. Found in the game menu under In Game Music. 
-	Optimized the game. It was very CPU bound before. We have spent some time optimizing the animals and other things to fix help this.
-	New, simpler tutorial
-	You can now toggle Crouch on or off. No longer do you need to hold it down.
-	You can now skip Intro Montages by pressing Enter on the keyboard.
-	Updated Minimap Images to be more simple and help save on memory.
-	Made Ticks less frequent.
-	Fixed numerous bugs.
-	Several other small features or fixes. 

The new map and new animals did not make it into this update. They will be saved for a future update along with and updated UI and some other new features.

We just want to thank everyone for their support and for the positive reviews. We hope enjoys the new update. Happy Hunting!

-The Abrams Studios Team

notes.title: BIG Spring Update!
notes.content:
Our Big Spring Update is live!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35848287/26df4c5ce11ae49482b59315325a6090ee5293ed.jpg[/img]

Let's go over the update.  Most of it was already listed in our last post about the update coming soon.

[h1]NEW ANIMALS:[/h1]

We have added several new animals like barn owls, sparrows, snapping turtles, and longhorn cattle. We have also added a new mystery animal for the Redwoods map.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/ae799b749233fe36ca5699de4784e61d9accd31b.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/ae799b749233fe36ca5699de4784e61d9accd31b.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/890629c1dd46d9c5d216d223e4821cdaeb3d3793.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/890629c1dd46d9c5d216d223e4821cdaeb3d3793.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]YOUR SEASON AFTER 100 DAYS:[/h1]

When you finish your season it will bring you back to the main cabin screen.  It will then reward you with a bag that allows you to start collecting poisonous mushrooms.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/db6dba316d71d4e6c38fe5d0344785747994f506.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/db6dba316d71d4e6c38fe5d0344785747994f506.jpg[/img][/url]

You will also now be able to view stats for any completed season and your career stats. Your game will have unlimited seasons and each season will keep adding to your career totals.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/7b01ff167ff0dddbd3d8bd2391adeae6d8e89216.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/7b01ff167ff0dddbd3d8bd2391adeae6d8e89216.jpg[/img][/url]

Anything you purchased, points, and your hunter's manual all get carried over to the next season as well.

[h1]MUSHROOM MARKERS:[/h1]

You can now pickup your markers and they will go back into your inventory.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/b6c6942a75336326af3a218c5b6dbbe3a206b634.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/b6c6942a75336326af3a218c5b6dbbe3a206b634.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]DIFFICULTY SETTING:[/h1]

We've added a difficulty setting. On Easy there will not be any ticks or poison ivy. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/46369c469d105f51389bf19c8d8800b5bd846264.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/46369c469d105f51389bf19c8d8800b5bd846264.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]EXPLORATION MODE:[/h1]

We've enabled Exploration Mode from the start of the game.  You no longer have to finish a season to try it out.  So if you were wanting to try it out but haven't finished a full season yet you will now be able to.  In this mode there are no seasons. You will get 25,000 points to start with, unlock all maps from the very beginning, and allow you to have some fun playing as animals.  This mode is for fun and anything you do will not count towards records, unlocking or achievements. 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/685baeacd8acb73e2e87abf2fa30d3684a6c8c5a.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/685baeacd8acb73e2e87abf2fa30d3684a6c8c5a.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]OTHER UPDATES AND FIXES:[/h1]

- We added a message in the shop that shows if you have already purchased an item. 

- There is a message that pops up when you click on Delete Game that asks you to confirm that you want to delete your game instead of just deleting it.

- Fixed the Hunter Level Achievement Bug if you were picking up with the New Look at Method. 

- We added an extra check for achievements completed whenever you are at the main cabin menu. 

- We are still working on a fix for the dead animal or wrong animal detected bug. Since we still have not been able to reproduce this bug on our end we won't know for sure if we have fixed it or not. We did some things that should help. If this happens to anyone else and you you are able to reproduce it please let us know how you were able to do it. 

We want to thank everyone who has taken the time to play Morels. It really means a lot to us.  We will continue to try and make Morels the best game that we can. If you ever have issues or problems with anything don't hesitate to contact us.  You can email your support questions to support@abramsstudios.com.  You can also contact us through our website's contact form.  http://www.abramsstudios.com/contact/.

Thank you, Enjoy the Update, and Happy Hunting!

-The Abrams Studios Team

notes.title: Morels The Hunt UPDATE!
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce our latest update for Morels: The Hunt. It is our biggest update yet.

[h1]HORSE[/h1]
-You can now ride a horse in Morels! 
-There will always be a horse for you to ride around on in the Texas Ranch map. 
-You can also purchase a horse from the shop to ride around on in other maps. 
-You can switch between first person and third person views while you are riding a horse.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35848287/b9d787e90c92e1525d31abc4e3af1a88fe2fe64d.png[/img]

[h1]NEW PICKUP METHOD[/h1]
-We created this method to pick up mushrooms on slopes, but you can pick up any mushroom with it. 
-If you are close enough you can look directly at a mushroom and hit the pickup button to pick it up. 
-You can also enable a CROSSHAIRS PICKUP GUIDE in Settings under Gameplay. This will put a little crosshairs on your screen that will turn green when you can pick up the mushroom. 
-Many players have also mentioned that it should not play the pickup animations unless there was something to pick up. It has now been changed to only playing pickup animations if the green circle is lit up showing you can pick up.
-There are a couple of sceenshots on our [url=www.abramsstudios.com/morels-support]Morels Support page[/url] on our website.

[h1]POISON IVY MECHANIC[/h1]
-You can now use your camera when you have poison ivy. It will close when you stop to scratch though.
-Increased the amount of time in between stopping and scratching from 10 seconds to a 15-25 seconds.
-Lowered the price of first aid kits.
-Poison Ivy had to still be a little punishing or there would be no point in trying to avoid it.

[h1]MORELS[/h1]
-Morels will now grow in all maps for your entire season. 
-Previously they would eventually die out around 35 days after the map was unlocked. 
The number of morels will eventually decrease a little after a map has been unlocked for so many days but they will never completely die out now.

[h1]TEXAS RANCH[/h1]
-Added a horse to ride around on.
-Increased the number of animals.
-Increased the number of mushrooms.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
-Fixed clock after midnight bug. Between 12AM and 1AM the clock would display weird combinations of numbers.
-Fixed mushrooms on slopes not being possible to pick up. You can now use the New Pickup Method to pick up mushrooms on slopes.
-Fixed being able to get stuck in the pig pen in Indiana Country.
-We have changed the method on how the game detects animals that are being photographed. Hopefully this will finally fix that pesky bug that sometimes will detect the wrong animal.

If we did not get to something in this update it will hopefully be in the next update. Thank you to everyone for all of the great feedback. We really appreciate all your support and we will continue to work to make Morels the best game that we can. Happy Hunting!

-The Abrams Studios Team
